WITH date_in_2002_march AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE year=2002 AND month=3
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*), count(*), count(*) 
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_in_2002_march dm ON ss_sold_date_sk = dm.d_date_sk
    WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_in_2002_march dm ON ws_sold_date_sk = dm.d_date_sk
    WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_in_2002_march dm ON cs_sold_date_sk = dm.d_date_sk
    WHERE c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk
)
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*), count(*), count(*) 
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*), count(*), count(*) LIMIT 100
